title: Lines of Light Over Yunnan: How a Meteor Shower Happens
title_zh: 云南上空的光之线：流星雨是怎样发生的
intro_zh: 本文约 533 词，共 8 个自然段，CET-4 核心词 6 个（spectacular、atmosphere、faint、observe、streak、capture）。文章围绕云南楚雄记录到的流星雨展开，介绍流星雨的成因、秋季与地点对观测的影响，以及肉眼观测和长时间曝光的拍摄方式，难度适中偏上，理解目标 85%–90%。

paragraphs.en: In the early hours of September 9, cameras in Chuxiong Yi Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, recorded a spectacular show in the night sky. Bright lines of light appeared one after another above the dark hills. The pictures spread quickly online, and people far away from Yunnan could see the same event on their screens without leaving home.
paragraphs.zh: 9月9日凌晨，云南省楚雄彝族自治州的摄像机记录下夜空中一场壮观的景象。明亮的线条一道道出现在幽暗山丘的上空。这些画面很快在网上传播开来，远在云南之外的人们不必出门，就能在屏幕上看到同一场天象。

paragraphs.en: A meteor shower is not really about stars falling. It begins when Earth passes through a stream of small particles left behind by a comet long ago. Most of these pieces are no bigger than a grain of sand, and many are much smaller. When they rush into the atmosphere, they heat up and burn, and we see them from the ground as short streaks of light. Nothing solid reaches us; the light is produced high above our heads.
paragraphs.zh: 流星雨其实并不是星星在坠落。当地球穿过很久以前一颗彗星留下的细小颗粒流时，流星雨便开始了。这些颗粒大多不比一粒沙子大，许多还要小得多。当它们高速冲入大气层时会受热燃烧，我们从地面看去，就成了一道道短暂的光条。没有任何固体落到我们身上；这些光产生在离我们头顶很高的地方。

paragraphs.en: What made the display easy to notice was the mixture of bright and faint lines. Some meteors flashed for a moment at the edge of the picture; others crossed the middle of the frame and stayed visible a little longer. Against a dark sky, even a small one draws the eye, and a single bright one can light up a whole photograph. Some of them also showed color — white, blue or green — depending on what the burning particles were made of.
paragraphs.zh: 让这场天象容易被注意到的是明亮与微弱光线交织在一起。有些流星在画面边缘一闪而过；另一些则划过画面中央，可见的时间稍长一些。在黑暗的天空背景下，哪怕很小的一颗也会吸引目光，而一颗明亮的流星足以照亮整张照片。有些还带有颜色——白色、蓝色或绿色——这取决于燃烧颗粒的成分。

paragraphs.en: Autumn is often a good season for watching the sky. Nights grow longer, so there are more hours of darkness to use. In places where the summer rains have ended, the air may hold less water as well, and a clearer sky makes dim light easier to see. Cooler evenings also keep more people indoors, which leaves parks and hillsides quiet.
paragraphs.zh: 秋天常常是观星的好季节。夜晚变长，可用的黑暗时间更多。在夏雨已经结束的地方，空气中的水汽也可能更少，而更清澈的天空让微弱的光更容易被看见。较凉的夜晚也让更多人待在室内，使公园和山坡变得安静。

paragraphs.en: The location mattered too. Chuxiong sits on a highland area of Yunnan, and much of the land around it is open and thinly populated. Away from the glow of large cities, the background sky is darker, so more meteors can be counted in the same amount of time. This is one reason why people travel out of town to observe the night sky.
paragraphs.zh: 地点也很重要。楚雄位于云南的高原地带，周围大片土地开阔、人烟稀少。远离大城市的灯光，背景天空更暗，因此同样的时间里能数到更多流星。这也是人们愿意出城去观察夜空的原因之一。

paragraphs.en: Watching these streaks needs no special equipment. A pair of eyes and a little patience are enough, which is one of the reasons such events attract so many people. It helps to lie back and look at a wide area of sky rather than a single point, and to let the eyes rest for about twenty minutes before starting. One look at a bright phone screen can undo that.
paragraphs.zh: 观看这些光条不需要特殊设备。一双眼睛和一点耐心就足够了，这也是这类天象能吸引如此多人的原因之一。最好躺下来，望向一大片天空，而不是盯着某一个点，并让眼睛先休息大约二十分钟再开始。看一眼明亮的手机屏幕，就可能让这一切前功尽弃。

paragraphs.en: Cameras can capture what our eyes miss. With a long exposure, a camera keeps collecting light for many seconds or even minutes, so a single photo may hold several streaks at once. That is how the images from Chuxiong showed so many lines in one frame. Video works in a similar way, joining hundreds of short pictures into a moving record.
paragraphs.zh: 相机能捕捉到我们眼睛错过的画面。使用长曝光时，相机会持续收集光线许多秒甚至几分钟，因此一张照片里可能同时留下好几道光条。楚雄的那些影像之所以能在一帧画面中呈现如此多的线条，正是这个道理。视频的原理也类似，它把成百上千张短照片连成一段动态记录。

paragraphs.en: A night like this is a reminder of something easy to forget. We live on a moving planet that travels through space at high speed, and the sky above us is never truly empty. The shower itself lasted only a short time, but the pictures taken that morning let many more people share in it, long after the sky had grown light again.
paragraphs.zh: 这样的夜晚提醒我们一件容易被忘记的事。我们生活在一颗高速穿越太空的移动行星上，头顶的天空从不真正空无一物。流星雨本身只持续了很短的时间，但那天早上拍下的照片，让更多人在天空重新变亮很久之后，仍能一同分享它。

questions.q: What produces the bright lines that people see during a meteor shower?
options: Stars falling out of the sky and landing on the ground.
Small particles heating up and burning in the atmosphere.
Light from a comet reaching the surface of Earth.
Reflections of city lights on high clouds.
questions.explain: 细节题。第二段说明流星雨来自彗星留下的小颗粒，它们冲入大气层后受热燃烧，从地面看去就是短促的光条，因此选第二项。第一项与文中“不是星星在坠落”矛盾；第三项与“没有任何固体落到我们身上、光产生在很高的地方”不符；第四项文中未提。

questions.q: Why does the passage mention that Chuxiong lies on a highland area with open, thinly populated land?
options: To explain why the region receives more summer rain.
To show that cameras work better in cold, high places.
To explain why the area offers darker skies for watching meteors.
To suggest the shower could only be seen from Yunnan.
questions.explain: 推断题。第五段指出该地开阔、人烟稀少，远离大城市灯光，背景天空更暗，因此能数到更多流星，可见提及地形与人口的目的是解释观测条件，故选第三项。其余选项均属无中生有或与文意相反。

questions.q: In the third paragraph, the word 'faint' is closest in meaning to
questions.explain: 词义题。faint 与 bright（明亮的）并列对照，指“微弱的、暗淡的”，与 weak 最接近。sudden 指“突然的”，colorful 指“多彩的”，distant 指“遥远的”，都不是与 bright 相对的含义，故选第一项。

questions.q: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: Photos of the night sky are always better than what human eyes can see.
Meteor showers are rare events that very few people are able to watch.
A recorded meteor shower in Yunnan is described and explained, together with what makes such displays visible.
Autumn is the only season in which shooting stars can appear.
questions.explain: 主旨题。全文由楚雄拍摄到的流星雨画面切入，解释其成因、季节与地点对观测的影响，以及肉眼与相机的观看方式，第三项概括最全面。第一项过于绝对；第二项与“无需特殊设备、吸引很多人”不符；第四项文中未提，且属于绝对化表述。
